moments.text: Infrared view looking down on layered clouds, teal crosshair at centre. A small white spot near the right edge drifts left toward the crosshair.
A teal square box with a black patch on its right edge opens around the crosshair; the white spot hovers close to its right side.
The box breaks into corner marks that slide below the crosshair, then vanish.
Crosshair only: the white spot swings from the upper right of the crosshair across to its left, then back toward the centre.
The teal box returns around the crosshair while clouds stream past; the spot stays just above and right of it.
The box again breaks into corner marks below the crosshair and vanishes at 51.7 s; the spot keeps just right of the crosshair over cloud banks.
The spot moves onto the crosshair and wobbles around its centre.
The spot drifts right, away from the crosshair, to about three-quarters of the way across the frame.
Over bright cloud the spot shows as a small dark dot, edging back toward the crosshair as the clip ends.
